description: Best measured configuration within each family and best broad coverage across the complete antenna inventory. Contexts remain distinct.

classification.broad <=2:1: at least 80% of the service window at or below 2:1 SWR
classification.broad <=3:1: at least 80% of the service window at or below 3:1 SWR
classification.partial only: at least 20% at or below 3:1 without broad coverage
classification.isolated resonance: less than 20% at or below 3:1, but an isolated minimum at or below 2:1
classification.gap: does not meet the partial threshold
